name: Tokyu Corporation
summary: Tokyu Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the transportation, real estate, life service, and hotel and resort businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates railways, including nine Tokyo lines in eastern Kanagawa Prefecture and 110.7 km of southwestern Tokyo with 99 stations. The company is also involved in urban development projects; runway maintenance and management for airports; railway inspection; and design and construction of railway-related electrical works.
